# SAHA Institute For Learning

> One-on-one tutoring institute in Kenner, Louisiana, serving students ages 4–17 since 2020. Subjects span academics, Islamic studies, and standardized test preparation — every class is taught one-on-one.

## About
- Founded in 2020 by Anila Siddiqui; has helped 200+ students.
- Location: 1201 Vintage Drive, Kenner, LA 70065.
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 3:15–9:00 PM.
- Phone: (504) 667-3625. Email: sahaforlearning@gmail.com.

## Programs
- Academics — one-on-one tutoring in mathematics, science, and reading & writing. $30/hour.
- Islamic Studies — Quran recitation, Tajwid, and memorization ($250/month); Qa'ida, beginning Quran Nazirah ($300/month).
- Standardized Test Prep — AP, ACT, and LEAP preparation. $30/hour.
- Summer Camp & STEM 2026 — a full-month program (June 1–30) for ages 4–17, with a dedicated STEM track for ages 9–17.
